_doc: Missions for the quest runner (story 9.1, entities/Quests.js). A mission has ordered `steps`; a step completes when a kid reaches its `reach` point ({ map, x, y } in tiles, `radius` in px, any player) or when its `event` fires (`match`: payload fields that must be equal, a list means any of them). `objective` is where the arrow points and `text` the line shown while the step is open (i18n keys mission.<id>.<key>). A mission starts at a phone booth (`booth: any`, only in the listed `phases` when given) or by itself when `trigger.event` fires. `kind` goes out with mission:done (help feeds Hilfsbereitschaft through data/kopfnoten.json). `reward` is paid to the shared wallet (cents) and to every player (xp); `repeat` lets it be played again each day. Intro and outro come from mission.<id>.intro / .done. More: objective `{ dynamic: stolenBike }` follows the hideout of the stolen bike; `lives` with `failOn` (events, counted from step `failFromStep` on) lets a fragile load take that many bumps before the mission fails (mission.<id>.hit / .fail) and can be started again; `skipIfFlag` skips a step whose goal is already met; `finishEvent` is emitted when the mission is done.
